title: Reconsider how Eshyra should reduce review and implementation churn
description:
Complex Eshyra work has repeatedly reached implementation before important
review boundaries were stable.

This bead owns a fresh diagnosis of that problem and the selection of a
proportionate approach.

Implementation must not begin until a new design is deliberately selected and
reviewed.
notes:
DESIGN SELECTION / AUTHORIZATION (2026-09-09, before repository edits): effective profile semantic-system because this changes durable review/process authority and lifecycle interpretation. Current authority and history were reconciled against AGENTS.md, ADR 0020, the accepted integrated transition design, eshyra-o9bd.19.7, eshyra-o9bd.19.1.14, eshyra-o9bd.19.16, eshyra-w65u / PR #505, eshyra-kusc / PR #527, docs/agent-captain-seats.md, current checked-in supervisor guidance, refs/beads/state, and live Beads. Selected approach: one provider-neutral canonical methodology document, a minimal AGENTS.md obligation/pointer, and lightweight extension of reviewLifecyclePolicy.test.ts. It promotes the operating model already selected and exercised: repository authority first; profiles select depth; exact-head approval; bounded fix verification only for demonstrably non-material repairs to a known class; full review for material repairs and persistent classes; terminal DESIGN_INVALIDATED; bounded vertical proof before semantic generalization; review of mechanisms and proof mechanisms. It introduces no review contract, hash, checkpoint, certification, review:* command, or second lifecycle. The user assignment supplies the explicit design selection for this process-policy implementation; accepted repository authority supplies the reconciled constraints. Implementation may now begin.
RETROSPECTIVE DIAGNOSIS AND IMPLEMENTATION (2026-09-09): The July failure mode was broader than implementation defects. Unsettled semantic concepts and proof assumptions were generalized across a large corpus before their trust boundaries were demonstrated, while implementers and reviewers lacked one stable shared authority model. The subsequent response selected a proportionate operating model in several accepted steps: (1) ADR 0020 and the integrated transition design replaced universal deterministic closure with provenance-backed rule awareness plus bounded positive capabilities; (2) F1, eshyra-o9bd.19.1.14, was narrowed to five real vertical proofs before generalization; (3) PR #481 and eshyra-review-v2 closed unmerged rather than accumulating contract/hash/checkpoint ceremony; (4) eshyra-w65u / PR #505 put authority-first review, profiles-as-depth, exact-head approval, bounded-vs-full rereview, terminal DESIGN_INVALIDATED, and blocking-findings discipline in AGENTS.md; (5) eshyra-o9bd.19.16 / PR #519 moved the PR-deliverable Bead lifecycle into common repository authority; (6) eshyra-kusc / PR #527 established Captain seats while keeping repository authority above personal seat state and handoffs; (7) subsequent review practice, especially the PR #527 repair sequence, exercised generalized defect classes, sibling searches, adversarial repair verification, proof-mechanism review, and escalation to fresh subsystem review. This PR adds docs/design-and-pr-review-policy.md as the one provider-neutral canonical detailed methodology, a minimal mandatory pointer in AGENTS.md, and lightweight extensions to packages/core/test/reviewLifecyclePolicy.test.ts. No new review framework is necessary because the architecture, lifecycle, ownership, review-depth profiles, exact-head state, and escalation model already exist; the missing piece was durable shared documentation of the full method. Scope remains policy/docs/tests only; no rules pack, schema, runtime, capability, campaign-rule, application, unrelated tooling, or Captain implementation changed. Effective profile: semantic-system. SELF-REVIEW: checked for contradictions with AGENTS.md and ADR 0020, duplicated authority, universal completeness or global negative requirements, stale PR #481 requirements, provider-specific authority, and obligations with no real mechanism; no blockers found. The only PR #481 reference marks it closed-unmerged and non-authoritative. VERIFICATION: npm run verify:worktree from .worktrees/o9bd-19-1-18 before commit; hidden-Unicode and Biome clean, forced TypeScript checks passed, 288 test files passed / 3 skipped, 5096 tests passed / 20 documented skips. The targeted reviewLifecyclePolicy test passed 12/12 before the full run. PR URL will be appended after opening. Bead remains in_progress until merge and continues to block eshyra-o9bd.19.1.14.

F2 canonical ownership: AGENTS.md and the new document both owned the same detailed rules.
